plan.title: The Fox and the Glowing Lantern

pages.scenario: A young fox with bright red fur finds a glowing golden lantern tucked under the branches of an old oak tree on a dark night.
The young fox carefully carries the luminous lantern across the tall grass of the open meadow towards the distant village lights.
The sleepy owl, perched high up on a stone turret, yawns widely before hanging the glowing lantern onto the church tower.
A powerful magic light spreads from the newly lit tower, making all the rooftops in the village shimmer with a brilliant silver glow.
Villagers dressed in blue and white clothing look out of their windows as they wake up to watch the beautiful stars together.
